# UX and Accessibility Checklist: Platform Picker

**Purpose**: Check that the Home picker requirements are complete, clear, and consistent for UX and accessibility, before `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the contents and order of a card (logo, name, one-line label, Continue note) specified, including where the note sits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the order of cards inside a section defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the section header texts and their accessibility roles (heading) specified? [Gap, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior defined when a logo image fails to load? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a loading state defined for the Continue note while the saved progress is being read? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the placement and look of the Settings entry and the Home button inside a flow specified (icon, label, position)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the exact label texts for each card and the Continue note written in the spec or contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "one short plain-words label" bounded by a length or word limit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "stay readable and tappable" tied to a minimum tap target size and a largest supported text size? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1-4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "without cutting off" in SC-004 defined for names and labels (wrap to how many lines, or truncate with what)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "smallest supported phone" defined with a screen size? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "back action" defined for each phone type (system gesture, on-screen button)? [Clarity, Spec §US2-7, §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the Continue note rules agree between US1 scenario 3, FR-007, and the Clarifications entry? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Does "Only one Automatic platform exists: the section header still shows" agree with "a section with no ready platform is hidden"? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the "tapping the note" action agree with "tapping a card" so a single card has one clear tap target for each? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the card label wording in FR-002 consistent with the label examples in US1 ("We subscribe for you") and the contract ("We move them for you")? [Conflict, Spec §US1, plan contract]

## Accessibility

- [ ] CHK017 Is the order a screen reader visits cards and the Continue note defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the accessibility label for the Continue note specified (count and action)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 Are color and contrast requirements for cards, logos on dark theme, and the note stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the logo's accessibility treatment (hidden from the screen reader because the card already names it) a requirement and not only a plan detail? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for opening a flow while a move is running and the user goes Home? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a reminder opening a progress while Settings is showing? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK023 Are layout requirements defined for tablets, folding phones, and landscape beyond "the grid reflows"? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the Continue note behavior defined when its count changes while Home is showing? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the logo size rule (YouTube's 100px minimum) resolved as a requirement, or listed as an assumption with an owner? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012, plan research R5]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that the project owner checks logo guidelines tied to a release gate? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers
